name: feedback-holder-presentation
description: Verify rejected actions and premium grants reach a visible Toast or RewardPop holder instead of telemetry-only feedback.

steps.label: start play and wait for runtime DataModels
prepare rejected rebirth and fresh premium state
request a gated rebirth through the player remote

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local function visibleChildren(holder) local n=0 for _,d in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do if d:IsA('GuiObject') and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 then n+=1 end end return n end local toast=visibleChildren(g.Toasts) local reward=visibleChildren(g.RewardPops) local presented=(g.Toasts.Visible and toast>0) or (g.RewardPops.Visible and reward>0) return H:JSONEncode({delta=(g:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)-(g:GetAttribute('FeedbackContractBefore') or 0),type=g:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType'),target=g:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget'),toastHolder=g.Toasts.Visible,toasts=toast,rewardHolder=g.RewardPops.Visible,rewards=reward,presented=presented})

steps.label: gated action renders visible rejection feedback
request the deterministic Studio premium pet grant
